title: Milwaukee with Doc Holley, and Carroll Dickerson
summary: Before Armstrong joined Oliver he spent a year or two in Milwaukee with Doc Holley's band at Lewis Castle Ice Garden, then came back to work with Carroll Dickerson.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
